facts.fact: Space in Africa states NIPOST switched on the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode on 1 October 2026, giving each captured addressable building an 11-character code.
Space in Africa states NIPOST has begun listing government service points, including birth and death registration centres, against their postcodes.
